parcels.title: Parcels
parcels.description: Parcels to look up: cadastral area (k.ú.) name or code and parcel number. Declined Czech names work ("Hrutově"). Use "st. 56" for a stavební parcela.

text.title: Czech text with parcel references
text.description: A public notice, contract or decision. Every "parc. č. …" / "p. č. …" / "st. p. č. …" with its k.ú. is extracted and looked up.

kuHint.title: Default k.ú. for the text
kuHint.description: Used for parcel numbers in the text that have no k.ú. nearby.

addresses.title: Addresses
addresses.description: Czech addresses, e.g. "Veveří 95, Brno" or "Hrutov 12". Each returns the official address point, WGS84 position and building data.

points.title: Points (WGS84)
points.description: [{"lat": 50.03, "lon": 13.87}] → k.ú., municipality, ORP, protected areas, mining areas.

exportKu.title: Export all parcels of a k.ú.
exportKu.description: k.ú. name or code. Writes a GeoJSON file of all its parcels to the key-value store.

withBuildings.title: Include buildings
withBuildings.description: Building on each stavební parcela and at each address (use, floors, flats, area, heating, connections).

withContext.title: Include protected areas
withContext.description: CHKO and zone, national park, Natura 2000, nature reserves, mining areas, soil unit (one extra request per result).

limit.title: Max results
limit.description: The run stops after this many dataset items.
